programs.description: Rama, Vivek's wife, is often criticized by her family for their optimistic and practical nature, but she supports them in times of need due to her good intentions.
Samar, a deep-sea diver, revisits the memories of his past relationships. He cherishes the moments of joy and appreciates the contribution of all the people who are a part of his life.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.

A woman faces several obstacles in life after her mother, an ardent devotee of a goddess, is transformed into a stone statue.

Ashok Vhatkar, a young boy, escapes his hostel to reach Kolhapur district. However, during his journey, people ill-treat him, and he learns the despair of poverty when he meets a woman and her family.
Two brothers, Abhay and Nirbhay, are surprised to meet their lookalikes. Just to try something new, they decide to swap their identities and see what it is like to live differently.
Kabir and his friends set off on a road trip to Karnataka and meet a quirky girl along the way. As the chaotic journey ensues, Kabir is forced to reunite with his father.
